sloka: अन्वीक्षमाणो रामः तु विषण्णम् भ्रान्त चेतसम् ।राजानम् मातरम् चैव ददर्श अनुगतौ पथि ॥२-४०-३९॥
transliteration: anvīkṣamāṇo rāmaḥ tu viṣaṇṇam bhrānta cetasam ।rājānam mātaram caiva dadarśa anugatau pathi ॥2-40-39॥

translations.english: When Rama glanced back, he saw his mother and father trailing behind him on the highway, with an agitated and dejected mind.
